account: It is day 0, just after 09:00. I came from home to the town hall to read my appointment book. Today's schedule is office correspondence at 08:00, a plaza market walk at 10:00, lunch at home at noon, town accounts in the office at 13:00, tea with a neighbour at a dockside cottage on the east bank at 15:00, office at 16:30, and home at 19:00. I have not yet confirmed which cottage hosts tea. Several townsfolk and a pupil have passed within sight near the hall; I have no evidence of anything unusual about their business. The secretary is nearby with a writable book and wants the schedule to keep appointments on plan. One small discrepancy is that the secretary said the appointments chest was empty and asked whether I had the book, although I had already returned it to the chest after reading. Their statement may refer to when I briefly held it; I do not know. I asked about correspondence and town news but have not yet received those details. So far I have seen no clear sign of an unusual event or organized activity in town.
